topics.name: Reconciliation Source Snapshot Freeze
topics.purpose: Define immutable source-tree snapshot used as the exact basis for one whole-tree reconciliation run.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reconciliation snapshot has explicit identity.
semantics.bootstrap_rule: Exact root Contract Format hash/revision is included.
semantics.source_rule: Exact canonical definition file paths/hashes are included.
semantics.history_rule: Excluded historical/generated file sets are recorded.
semantics.patch_rule: Applied patch/revision provenance is recorded where available.
semantics.immutability_rule: Any source change produces a new snapshot/reconciliation run.
semantics.authority_rule: Snapshot freeze is analysis evidence, not repository write lock.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

hard_gates.condition: tree changes mid-run without new snapshot
snapshot means repo cannot change operationally
